metric: Minified + gzip size of a full-package import in a browser bundle. Sizes are in bytes; kB means 1,000 bytes.
note: Rows are historical fixtures recorded when each release was measured. Fixtures and tooling differ between rows, so compare trends rather than small differences. The current release is measured by scripts/measure-bundle.mjs and stored in docs/bundle-data.json.
